real_session_audit.snapshot: local logs present on 25 Sep 2026; no fixed lookback window
real_session_audit.candidate_definition: A token of at least 10 characters containing a digit appeared in a tool result before the first compaction and in assistant prose after the third; it was absent from earlier/later user prose and the third compacted payload.
real_session_audit.limits: Lexical overlap is a candidate, not proven dependence or improved answer accuracy. Semantic paraphrases are missed. Only the smallest eligible candidate per host was replayed. No raw log data was committed.

model_choice.population: Synthetic long-session fixture after three compactions; Claude Sonnet low effort; one run per case unless stated
model_choice.token_definition: CLI input, cache-creation, cache-read and output tokens; includes fixed host context; not a billing estimate
model_choice.isolation: Disposable local skill with branch CLI and synthetic index; original transcript deleted; no explicit lookup command in the question

failed_result.exact_score: unscorable; do not count as wrong-value answers

structured_output_probe.method: Eval-only Claude CLI JSON Schema constraint; evaluator requires the structured_output field and never falls back to free-form text in this mode; production skill unchanged
structured_output_probe.limits: Positive, missing and uncued controls each ran once and are smoke checks, not rate estimates. This small synthetic probe does not establish live answer accuracy or make the production plugin enforce JSON.

model_choice.limits: Small synthetic sample and same-model tuning; not a live-session accuracy or general token-saving claim. Free-form failed-result answers can still violate a requested JSON format.

windows.host: native Windows Claude Code 2.1.281 with Git Bash and a disposable enabled plugin copy
windows.nonpersistent_control: Claude supplied a transcript path but no file under --no-session-persistence; the index remained empty.
windows.limits: Used the normal authenticated Windows profile with isolated settings and temporary plugin source; a clean authenticated installation smoke and macOS remain unverified.

clean_marketplace_install.platform: Linux/WSL Claude Code in an empty temporary config directory
clean_marketplace_install.limit: An isolated clean profile returned api_error for a model call even without the plugin, on both Linux and Windows; the precise environment cause was not determined. No credential files were copied. This validates package installation only; authenticated installed-host hook delivery remains unverified.

native_windows_clean_marketplace_install.platform: native Windows Claude Code 2.1.281 with a temporary config and a local archive of the current committed source
native_windows_clean_marketplace_install.limit: The UNC-path add failure was not diagnosed. This validates native package installation from a local Windows path, not authenticated installed-host hook delivery.

product_decision: Capture remains explicitly opt-in. The local outcome counter stores labels and counts only; it does not store query text or leave the session database.
